detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation and Investigation
detail.question: Can an intelligent process independently identify a worthwhile problem that nobody explicitly assigned, recognize its significance, and sustain an investigation toward resolving it?
detail.reason: Transitioning from feasibility of goal generation to the development of a structured framework for evaluating problem significance. New sources (source-1584048d2f9a44ab, source-63ab732f84604b1e) provide the necessary theoretical grounding to define significance markers without human intervention.
